scope: Exact eager NGRAM c32 hidden-state capture producer only; no retrieval, checkpoint materialization, model-quality claim, or performance claim.

bounded_owner_destination.deadline_rule: min(claimed_at + 45 minutes, registered bench lifecycle deadline - 10 minutes)

launcher_amendments_from_prior_terminal: Translate coordinator-local hook paths to the immutable /work/input container mount.
Provide the endpoint entrypoint's required FP8_MODULE_AUDIT, FP8_CONSUMER_AUDIT, and FP8_RUNTIME_AUDIT destinations.
Retain --disable-cuda-graph so the Python observer sees live TARGET_VERIFY rows rather than graph-capture placeholders.

expected_capture_identities.observer_tripwire: Any capture_hook_install_error or capture_observer_error makes the attempt an invalid observer result; preserve raw responses and capture bytes, submit no later arm, and repair only capture/consumer handling under the same claim.

minimum_authority: An explicitly compatible nvidia-h200-sxm lab bench released by its predecessor.
A lifecycle deadline that admits the bounded owner deadline.
The exact checkpoint revision staged by the future durable owner from a verified project-bound manifest; this packet deliberately contains no checkpoint bytes.
later_h200_claim_contract.claim: Atomically claim through grad_research.gpu_pool for project gemma4_adaptive_retrieval_vocab_head; never create or tear down a provider resource.
later_h200_claim_contract.durability: Start the controller-host process with research/factory/tools/detached-owner --unit-manager pid and record its emitted pid, start_ticks, owner-state unit path, artifact root, and absolute deadline in STATUS.json.active_session.
staging: Transfer the content-addressed packet archive, verify archive and member hashes, and atomically finalize remote_packet_root.

Inside the same durable claim owner, reconcile the exact checkpoint size-and-hash manifest, preserve matched files, transfer only missing or mismatched files to temporary paths, verify them, and atomically finalize immutable names.
Pull or reuse only the pinned image digest and validate the direct runtime source hashes before server launch.
Do not resolve any sibling project or shared mutable source path after the claim.
later_h200_claim_contract.science_start: Write science_started only after packet, image, checkpoint, runtime-source, server-health, and workload identities pass and immediately before the single exact_runner.py c32 request submission.
later_h200_claim_contract.repair: A launcher, import, observer, parser, path, API, numeric-guard, archive, or retrieval defect retains the same claim and healthy runtime. Persist a compact diagnostic, open a fresh repair-handshake generation, and retry only the invalidated unconsumed operation.
later_h200_claim_contract.producer_consumption: A complete 32-request c32 workload plus durable raw responses is consumed once. If capture validation or retrieval fails afterward, preserve that producer output and repair only the observer consumer or retrieval; do not replay the c32 producer.
later_h200_claim_contract.retrieval_order: Retrieve the compact terminal, capture hash, manifest, raw stdout/stderr, and science-start marker before the bulk hidden-state payload. Missing retrieval is a recoverable same-claim defect.
forbidden: No retrieval-head experiment or offline retrieval consumer during this capture admission.
No second c32 producer run after a complete interpretable first producer.
No provider creation, teardown, or disk lifecycle mutation by the researcher.

later_h200_release_contract.success: After a decision-bearing capture and compact artifact retrieval, update actual_spend_usd from the full continuous claim interval. Keep a healthy exact server resident; absent an explicitly prebound compatible successor, release the bench to maintenance with container name, port, accelerator-memory occupancy, packet/checkpoint/image identities, and capture location.
later_h200_release_contract.recoverable_failure: Do not release. Keep the claim heartbeating and the healthy server/checkpoint/image/packet resident while the repair handshake is actionable.
later_h200_release_contract.terminal_failure: Release to maintenance only after retrieving the compact diagnostic and submission markers when the guest is unsafe or unreachable, the absolute deadline requires handoff, or an informative incompatibility is decision-bearing.
later_h200_release_contract.unoccupied_successor_ready: If the experiment server has already exited and the accelerator is healthy and unoccupied, preserve the image, checkpoint, packet, and caches, update resident contents, and release ready.
later_h200_release_contract.never: Never retire the bench or invoke provider/disk cleanup; lifecycle disposition belongs to the director.
